title: Delhi records minimum temperature of 24.6°C, thunderstorms with rain likely
summary: The IMD on Saturday (May 2, 2026) issued a 'yellow' alert for the national capital for the next two days, warning of rain, thunderstorms and gusty winds. The cloudy skies and intermittent rain are expected to persist till May 6

title: EC makes final preparations for counting of votes at 62 centres across Tamil Nadu
summary: Chief Electoral Officer Archana Patnaik holds review meeting with with Election Commission officials ahead of counting day on May 4

title: Silence, the court is in session
summary: The resignation of Allahabad High Court judge Yashwant Varma last month, amid parliamentary proceedings to remove him over allegations that burnt wads of unaccounted cash were found at his Delhi residence in 2025, has brought into focus how the judiciary holds itself to account. Aaratrika Bhaumik reports on the opacity surrounding complaints against judges, the routine rejection of information requests, and the shrinking space for criticism

title: MP boat tragedy: Death toll climbs to 13; body of last missing person recovered
summary: The boat, around 20 years old and operated by the State tourism department, capsized during a storm on April 30, 2026

title: Assembly elections 2026 LIVE: All preparations for counting completed, says Kerala CEO
summary: Special counting tables have been arranged for postal ballots, with each table handling up to 500 votes under the supervision of an assistant returning officer.

title: West Bengal election: Hundreds stage protest over ‘threats’ by TMC workers in Falta
summary: The CRPF deputy commandant visited the area with a large force and assured the demonstrators of ensuring their safety.

title: Opposing campaigns in Kerala map out the best- and worst-case scenarios for their respective alliances
summary: Exit polls favouring UDF leave the Opposition feeling bullish. LDF feels voters will stay the course as in the past Assembly elections, preferring “stability over volatility”. The BJP-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) is hoping to shrink the UDF and LDF’s margins by positioning itself as a Central government-backed development alternative to the traditional fronts in Kerala.

title: High turnout for repoll in 15 West Bengal booths; peaceful amid tight security
summary: Protests erupt in Falta over BJP’s allegations of malpractice and voter harassment, with a decision on repolls in the seat still pending
